featured.title: Flock
featured.subtitle: Real-time platform for local communities
featured.summary: Helps people discover nearby communities and organize in-person meetups.
keyFeatures: Built a Go REST API & dedicated WebSocket server for live presence & RSVP updates with Redis pub/sub for horizontal scaling across replicas.
Designed geo-spatial data layer using PostgreSQL + PostGIS with a quantized-grid Redis caching strategy to keep location queries fast at scale.
Integrated Clerk for authentication, Google Maps Platform API for location search/geocoding, and Meilisearch for full-text search across communities and events.

featured.title: Paylio
featured.subtitle: Personal finance and portfolio tracking
featured.summary: Combines investment holdings and bank transactions in a single finance workspace.
keyFeatures: Integrated Zerodha Kite Connect to sync holdings, encrypt stored broker credentials, and generate daily portfolio snapshots.
Built three-stage transaction categorization with learned merchant mappings, keyword rules, and an asynchronous local LLM fallback. Added CSV statement import and account-level duplicate prevention.
Built a test suite across 28 files covering imports, categorization, budgets, APIs, and integrations.

featured.title: AlgoNext
featured.subtitle: Browser-based coding and online judge
featured.summary: Lets students run code in a sandbox and explore algorithm visualizations.
keyFeatures: Implemented an in-browser code editor using Monaco Editor, integrated with Judge0 for sandboxed multi-language code execution and automated judging.
Designed a Django REST Framework backend with Celery and Redis for async task processing, PostgreSQL (Supabase) for storage, and Node.js for build scripts.
Implemented Clerk for authentication; deployed frontend on Vercel and backend on Render.

featured.title: RegTech Investigation Workspace
featured.subtitle: AI-assisted financial fraud investigation
featured.summary: A Streamlit workspace for reviewing synthetic KYC and transaction data with an auditable trail.
keyFeatures: Built a synthetic-data pipeline for KYC profiles and transaction logs, with detection logic in progress for structuring and rapid fund movement.
Designed a reasoning audit trail to support human review of regulator-facing output.
